BTS Group's First Trading Day

Back 11 May 2010

BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited or BTS Group was traded for the first day under its new company name on May 1th 2010. The event was chaired by Mr. Keeree Kanjanapas, Chairman of BTS Group, attended by distinguished guests i.e. Mr. Sompol Kiatphaibool (fourth from left), SET Chairman; Mrs. Patareeya Benjapolchai (sixth from left), SET President and Miss Ornkanya Pibuldham (far right), Managing Director, Head of Global Markets and Global Corporate Finance, Deutsche Bank AG, Bangkok Branch.
